variants.prompt: Cho tứ diện <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi><mi>D</mi></mrow></semantics></math> có <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>a</mi></mrow></semantics></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>C</mi><mi>D</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>a</mi></mrow></semantics></math>. Gọi <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi></mrow></semantics></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>N</mi></mrow></semantics></math> lần lượt là trung điểm của <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi></mrow></semantics></math> và <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>D</mi></mrow></semantics></math>. Biết rằng <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi><msqrt><mrow><mn>19</mn></mrow></msqrt></mrow></semantics></math>, hãy tính tích vô hướng <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>⋅</mo><mover><mrow><mi>C</mi><mi>D</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover></mrow></semantics></math>.
variants.solution:
Ta có 2NM→=AB→+DC→=AB→−CD→.
Bình phương vô hướng hai vế: 4MN2=AB2+CD2−2AB→⋅CD→.
Suy ra AB→⋅CD→=−12a2.
